verdict.rationale: Evidence only tangentially touches DNS hosting: RDAP shows DNSSEC (delegationSigned/zoneSigned) support and community notes Namecheap offers Dynamic DNS as a free extra, implying some DNS hosting capability. There is no evidence about the breadth of record types supported, TTL settings, or the quality/usability of the DNS management UI. missing for 10: documentation of supported record types (A, AAAA, MX, TXT, CNAME, SRV, CAA, etc.), TTL configurability, and any hands-on account of the DNS UI experience.
